llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及SLM铺粉过程的数值模拟，与生物医学植入物或骨整合等方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on powder laying numerical simulation for SLM, with no biomedical context, no implant design or testing, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing, and no osseointegration.

summary_en.motivation: To predict powder layer quality in selective laser melting by simulating the powder spreading process.
summary_en.method: Discrete element method (DEM) was used to model particle dynamics during powder laying.
summary_en.result: The simulation accurately predicted powder layer thickness and uniformity under different process parameters.
summary_en.validation: Model predictions were validated against experimental measurements of powder layer characteristics.
